sites.name: Gadget & Gear
sites.note: Apple Authorised Reseller (official); one page per config/colour. Every older Air (M1–M4) page is currently Stock Out but still shows the official price, used as officialPrice.

sites.name: Apple Gadgets
sites.note: Apple-focused importer (unofficial). M1/M2/M3 Air pages are single-config and out of stock; M4 13/15 pages list three configs (in stock / pre-order).

sites.name: Sumash Tech
sites.note: Unofficial importer with inflated strike-through prices; most older Air configs out of stock. M3 15" page exposes only the default 8/256GB price.

sites.name: Kry International
sites.note: Unofficial; per-config prices with region on some options (USA). M2/M3 pages skipped: option prices are inconsistent (bigger configs cheaper).

sites.name: iStockBD
sites.note: Shopify, unofficial; per-config prices incl. custom 1TB/2TB/32GB builds (only standard configs used).

sites.name: Mobile Buzz BD
sites.note: WooCommerce, unofficial; one M4 page holds both 13" and 15" options (size option '13'/'15'); used only for 13" because new-product matching confuses the sizes.

sites.name: MacZen BD
sites.note: Unofficial Mac importer; M4 13/15 pages list 16/256 and 16/512 only.

sites.name: Diamu
sites.note: WooCommerce, unofficial; M4 13/15 pages in stock. Older M1/M2/M3 Air URLs return nothing; the M3 13"-slug page is titled 15-inch, so skipped.

sites.name: CustomMacBD
sites.note: Shopify, unofficial (international warranty); options split by warranty claim type / pre-order. M3 pages skipped: option prices are inconsistent.

sites.name: MC Solution
sites.note: WooCommerce, unofficial imports; one page per config. Several old Air URLs redirect to newer models (skipped).

sites.name: PCB Store
sites.note: Gaming/PC store, importer channel (unofficial); single-config Air pages, all stock out.
